scripts.cleanup: yarn cleanCache & yarn workspaces foreach -A -p exec rm node_modules -r -force
scripts.nodeLink: cd $INIT_CWD && node -e "let fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('node_modules')){fs.symlink('../../node_modules','node_modules', 'dir', (err) => console.log(err || 'Done.'))} "
scripts.temp: yarn workspaces foreach -A --exclude '.' --exclude 'oc-metro' exec yarn run -T nodeLink
scripts.add:lib: cd $PROJECT_CWD/libs && mkdir mylibraryname && cd mylibraryname && yarn init -p -n '@oc/mylibraryname' && node -e "require('fs').appendFile('index.tsx','export const myTest = \'Some words\';',function(err){if(err) throw err;console.log('Saved!');}); "

scriptsComments.nodeLink: Changes dir to $INIT_CWD. When running a top-level script against child workspaces we need to change to the right directory.
scriptsComments.postinstall: Only gets run after node_modules is deleted, or if a new file is added.
scriptsComments.$INIT_CWD: $INIT_CWD will always point to the directory running the script.
scriptsComments.$PROJECT_CWD: $PROJECT_CWD will always point to the root of your project.
scriptsComments.teardown: Terminate all adb connections, kill server, prevents file locks.
